name: Kijou Suzuka
source:
A cool and sadistic daughter of the oni tribe, who is in her second year of high school, Taichi's junior.

Suzuka was confessed to by Taichi, but turned him down without mercy.

Because of "Awakening Essence", Suzuka is told by her mother to ensnare Taichi so that her clan could monopolize him.
